description_en: Queries the list of LoRaWAN join permissions
description_zh: 调用该接口查询LoRaWAN入网凭证列表
name: QueryLoRaJoinPermissions

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value is displayed for a public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

JoinPermission.description_en: The join permission data (JoinPermission) returned if the call was successful
JoinPermission.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的入网凭证数据（JoinPermission）

ClassMode.description_en:
The communication mode used by the join permission. Valid values:

A: The end device allows bidirectional communication.
B: The end device opens receive windows at preset times.
C: The end device keeps receive windows open continuously and closes them only during transmission
ClassMode.description_zh:
入网凭证采用的通信模式。取值：

A：终端设备允许双向通信。
B：终端设备会在预设时间中开放接收窗口。
C：终端设备持续开放接收窗口，只在传输时关闭

Enabled.description_en:
The enabled or disabled status of the join permission. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
入网凭证的启停用状态。取值：

true：启用。
false：停用

JoinPermissionId.description_en: The join permission ID, which is the unique identifier of the join permission
JoinPermissionId.description_zh: 入网凭证ID，入网凭证的唯一标识

JoinPermissionName.description_en: The name of the join permission

JoinPermissionType.description_en:
The type of the join permission. Valid values:

LOCAL: Dedicated join permission.
ROAMING: Roaming join permission
JoinPermissionType.description_zh:
入网凭证的类型。取值：

LOCAL：专用凭证。
ROAMING：漫游凭证

OwnerAliyunPk.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission creator
OwnerAliyunPk.description_zh: 入网凭证创建者的阿里云账号ID

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device that uses this join permission belongs
ProductKey.description_zh: 使用该凭证的设备所属产品的ProductKey

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
